name: Gulfstream G650 / G700 / G800
summary: Gulfstream's flagship ultra-long-range jets with the widest Gulfstream cabin and the brand's largest oval windows.

wings: Low wing with strong sweep and large blended, sharply raked winglets
engines: Two large Rolls-Royce BR725 or Pearl 700 turbofans in big nacelles on the rear fuselage
fuselage: Wide, round fuselage with very large oval windows
Blunt, rounded nose with very large windscreen panes
tail: T-tail with a tall swept fin

tellTales: Very large oval windows on a wide, round fuselage
Blunt rounded nose with very large windscreen panes
Strongly swept wing with large blended winglets

confusedWith.howToTell: The G650/G700 is fatter with larger ovals, a blunter nose and a more swept wing; the GIV/G550 is slimmer with a pointed nose and smaller ovals.
The G650/G700 has oval windows; the Global series has rounded-rectangle windows.
The G650/G700 has two engines and a T-tail; the Falcon 7X/8X has three engines and a cruciform tail.

usCount.source: Gulfstream deliveries (~550 G650/ER plus 100+ G700/G800) with ~55% US-registered per JETNET fleet summaries (approx.)
